questions.prompt: When it was asked of the consul what should be done, he remained silent for a long time.
questions.answer: Ā quō cum quaererētur quid faciendum esset, diū tacuit.

questions.prompt: Both brothers set out together to the war, their weeping mother left behind.
questions.answer: Ambō frātrēs ūnā ad bellum profectī sunt, mātre flente relictā.

questions.prompt: Each of the two generals, when he was praised by the soldiers, blushed.
questions.answer: Uterque dux, cum ā mīlitibus laudārētur, ērubuit.

questions.prompt: In each camp the guards, whom the enemy feared, kept watch through the night.
questions.answer: In utrīsque castrīs custōdēs, quōs hostēs timēbant, per noctem vigilābant.

questions.prompt: The general arrived, and when it was asked of him what he wanted, he demanded grain.
questions.answer: Dux vēnit, ā quō cum quaererētur quid vellet, frūmentum poposcit.

questions.prompt: Both consuls returned to the city together, once the enemy had been conquered.
questions.answer: Ambō cōnsulēs ūnā in urbem revertērunt, hostibus victīs.

questions.prompt: Each of the two poets recited his own verses in the forum.
questions.answer: Uterque poēta suōs versūs in forō recitāvit.

questions.prompt: The generals on each side, whose courage all admired, made ready for battle.
questions.answer: Utrīque ducēs, quōrum virtūtem omnēs mīrābantur, ad proelium sē parāvērunt.

questions.prompt: A witness was summoned, and when it was asked of him who had committed the crime, he was silent.
questions.answer: Testis arcessītus est, ā quō cum quaererētur quis facinus commīsisset, tacuit.

questions.prompt: Both sisters, weeping bitterly, buried their father with great honor.
questions.answer: Ambae sorōrēs, ācriter flentēs, patrem magnō honōre sepelīvērunt.

questions.prompt: Each of the two roads leads to the sea, but neither is safe.
questions.answer: Utraque via ad mare dūcit, sed neutra tūta est.

questions.prompt: In each set of camps the soldiers, exhausted by the long march, slept.
questions.answer: In utrīsque castrīs mīlitēs, longō itinere fessī, dormiēbant.

questions.prompt: When it was asked of the philosopher what most benefits mankind, he answered 'wisdom.'
questions.answer: Ā quō cum quaererētur quid hominibus maximē prōdesset, sapientia respondit.

questions.prompt: Both armies pitched camp together on the same hill.
questions.answer: Ambō exercitūs ūnā in eōdem colle castra posuērunt.

questions.prompt: Each of the two maidens sang a song sweeter than the nightingale.
questions.answer: Utraque virgō carmen lusciniā dulcius cecinit.

questions.prompt: The leaders on both sides, whom fortune had favored, feared nothing.
questions.answer: Utrīque ducēs, quibus fortūna fāverat, nihil timēbant.

questions.prompt: A captive was brought forward, and when it was asked of him where the gold lay hidden, he lied.
questions.answer: Captīvus prōductus est, ā quō cum quaererētur ubi aurum latēret, mentītus est.

questions.prompt: Both boys, having hurled their spears, fled through the woods.
questions.answer: Ambō puerī, hastīs iactīs, per silvās fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: Each of the two judges gave a different opinion about the accused man.
questions.answer: Uterque iūdex dīversam sententiam dē reō dīxit.

questions.prompt: The citizens on each side, whose city the war had exhausted, longed for peace.
questions.answer: Utrīque cīvēs, quōrum urbem bellum exhauserat, pācem cupiēbant.

questions.prompt: The old woman was led in, and when it was asked of her where her son was hiding, she wept.
questions.answer: Anus intrōducta est; ā quā cum quaererētur ubi fīlius latēret, flēvit.

questions.prompt: Each of the two sisters, adorned with gold, entered the temple alone.
questions.answer: Utraque soror aurō ōrnāta templum sōla intrāvit.

questions.prompt: Both generals, having joined their forces, attacked the enemy together.
questions.answer: Ambō ducēs cōpiīs coniūnctīs hostem ūnā oppugnāvērunt.

questions.prompt: In each camp the watchfires blazed through the whole night.
questions.answer: In utrīsque castrīs ignēs tōtā nocte ārsērunt.

questions.prompt: When it was asked of the merchant where he had hidden his wealth, he lied boldly.
questions.answer: ā quō cum quaererētur ubi dīvitiās cēlāvisset, audācter mentītus est.

questions.prompt: Both daughters, adorned with garlands, approached the altar together.
questions.answer: ambae fīliae, sertīs ōrnātae, ūnā ad āram accessērunt.

questions.prompt: Each of the two kings, when he was warned by the seer, scorned the omen.
questions.answer: uterque rēx, cum ā vāte monērētur, ōmen sprēvit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers on each side, whom the long war had wearied, longed for their homes.
questions.answer: utrīque mīlitēs, quōs longum bellum fatīgāverat, domōs suās dēsīderābant.

questions.prompt: When it was asked of the sailor whither the storm had driven the ship, he pointed to the rocks with his finger.
questions.answer: ā quō cum quaererētur quō tempestās nāvem ēgisset, saxa digitō mōnstrāvit.

questions.prompt: Both consuls, having set aside their disagreement, defended the city together.
questions.answer: ambō cōnsulēs, discordiā dēpositā, urbem ūnā dēfendērunt.

questions.prompt: Each of the two philosophers gave a different answer about the soul.
questions.answer: uterque philosophus dē animō dīversum respōnsum dedit.

questions.prompt: In each camp the watchmen, fearing an ambush, kept the fires burning.
questions.answer: in utrīsque castrīs vigilēs, īnsidiās timentēs, ignēs ārdentēs servābant.
